svg.title: How long each vaccine protects
svg.desc: Horizontal bars showing the typical duration of vaccine-induced protection: smallpox vaccine beyond a lifetime, measles vaccine decades, HPV vaccine ten years and counting, tetanus vaccine about ten years, influenza and COVID-19 vaccines only a few months.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One immune system, very different lifespan of protection
